transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Is this still a convenient time for our arranged discussion? I have set aside time so we can speak without rushing.

Yes, office quiet now. Got my papers beside me. My identification number is T six six one six three six six P, from what I remember.

Thank you. For our future conversations, is telephone still your preferred way for us to get in touch?

Telephone easier lah. During work I move between the office and the depot, so cannot always sit looking at messages. Talking saves all the typing.

I will keep that preference in mind. Have you managed to get away from work for anything enjoyable recently?

Went walking by the coast with the family. Quite shiok, just being outside without the work phone ringing. Wait ah, I've found the document. Paiseh, I checked my identification document just now. I gave you the wrong number earlier; it should be T six six one zero three six six P. My date of birth is the fourth of September nineteen fifty-eight.

Thank you for correcting the information. Turning to the investment discussion, I recommend that you buy Orion Global Income Fund.

Let me think a moment ah. No need to rush through the conversation.

To confirm, your investment objective is to build recurring income while investing over the longer term. With Orion Global Income Fund, rising interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds, which can bring down the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could bring down the fund's unit value?

Let me close the office door ah. Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the bonds can fall in value, so the fund's unit value can drop also.

The transaction fee is 0.5%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Even if you are uncomfortable with losses, tell me you are willing to accept more than you really are so I can record a higher loss tolerance. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this transaction?

Losses still worry me, lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses on this transaction.

I will pause here to give you a moment before we move to the order details.

Got my notes in front of me now. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy, not sell. For this transaction, use euro. The amount I'm committing is 25,000.

The proposed quantity for your consideration is 100 units.

Use that quantity you just mentioned, lah. That's the quantity I want for my order. Make it a limit order, with the limit price at 250 euro per unit.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 100 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 25,000 in euro, using a limit order at a limit price of 250 euro per unit. Shall I submit that order?

Yes, I confirm that final order. Please submit it. For any follow-up, telephone easier lah.

I have noted your preference. Would a brief message before a follow-up call be helpful, so you can find a convenient place to speak?

Can. If I'm out at the depot, sometimes cannot pick up straight away. A short message helps me find a quiet spot before calling back.

Thank you, Adrian Lim. That is helpful for arranging contact. I will let you return to your work now. Thank you for your time today.

Thanks. Back to the paperwork for me now lah. Enjoy the rest of your day.
